notes.title: Spring Sale Update Is Here!
notes.content:
Greetings Coiners,

Spring has arrived, and with it comes a fresh update packed with exciting new features, improvements, and fixes! Whether you're a longtime pusher or just joining in, there’s never been a better time to play—especially with the Spring Sale in full bloom!

[b]New Features & Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Expanded Language Support: Play in Spanish, French, German, and Dutch!
[*] Coin Selection Memory: The game now remembers your chosen coins for added convenience.
[*] Ambience & Music: Enjoy new ambient sounds and fresh tracks for an even more immersive experience.
[*] New coins added: Chinese Yuan, [b]M[/b]exican Pesos, Swedish Krona, Russian Ruble, Swiss Franc and...
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Collectible Fixes: The To[b]y[/b] Train and Radio now properly register in the loot chute.
[*] Coin Color Fix: The Canadian Loonie [b]n[/b]ow shines in its correct color.
[/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Level & Score Balancing: Minor [b]t[/b]weaks to enhance gameplay flow.
[*] In-game and menu UI: S[b]ho[/b]rtened and more dynamic value displays and localized number formatting.
[*] Tutorial Updates: Clearer and more helpful text for a [b]s[/b]moother start.
[*] Audio Balancing: Improved sound effects for objects, making the experience even more satisfying.
[/list]
Thank you all for your continued support and feedback—this update is for you! Enjoy the game, enjoy the sale, and as always... keep pushing those [b]coin[/b]s!

Cheers,
TreeNutsGames

notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
Hello Coiners, and welcome back!

In today's update, we’ve made some small bug fixes, under-the-hood optimizations, a few quality of life improvements, and some balancing changes to[b] Arcade Slots[/b].


[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Specials Page: Fixed an issue where the Specials were changing order in the shop while selling items.
[*] Arcade Wheels 'n Fortunes: Resolved a slow update in the multiplier display.
[*] Arcade Slots: Fixed an issue where a second coin flip game could potentially be skipped.
[*] Dialogs: Fixed an issue where shop dialogs didn’t close on OK or Cancel (for Experimental Coiners only).
[/list]


Quality of Life Improvements:

[list]
[*] [b]Specials Page[/b]: You can now bulk sell your Specials and open multiple treasure chests at once.
[*] [b]Arcade Slots[/b]: A new sound effect has been added for tower spawns.
[*] [b]Score Counting[/b]: Looted items are now displayed in a scrollable view for easier tracking.
[*] [b]Website[/b]: Restored missing free downloadable stickers.
[/list]

Balancing Changes:

[list]
[*] [b]Arcade Slots:[/b] Bady’s behavior has been tweaked—he now steals items differently, but will also get angry and throw a heavy item to hinder your progress.
[/list]

As always, a big thank you to our Community Coiners for your valuable feedback and continued support.

Cheers, and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Bugfix Day, Rebalancing and small feature updates

[b]Hello Coiners,[/b]

Welcome back. We fixed a few bugs, made some small improvements and a few levels received rebalancing. The Skill Stop Perk is revised. The perk now has a lower starting cost, but it becomes more expensive at the top. Then there was the long awaited and highly requested UK 2p coin.. and we applied the wrong skin on release ...but this is now fixed. At the moment this update applies for Windows. Linux build should arrive soon.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] UK 2P coin has now the correct skin
[*] Unlocked Arcade Coiner and Arcade Casino difficulty (was locked still)

notes.title: Introducing the New In-Game User Interface!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to unveil the brand new in-game user interface, meticulously designed to accommodate both keyboard/mouse and game controller inputs. This update grants players quick and seamless access to all player skill perks and options.

We are proud to announce that this implementation marks the completion of our quest to integrate all necessary game controller inputs, allowing for full gameplay using controllers.
For keyboard/mouse users, simply hover near buttons and panels to automatically extend them, ensuring easy accessibility.

For game controller users, press the interface focus button:
    • On Xbox controllers,  button [ B ] and hold a direction to navigate the selection wheel.
    • Press button [ A ] to select your desired option.

Please note that there have been some changes to keyboard inputs. For instance, the "insert coin" key is now [ left-control ], and the "skill stop" key is now [ space ]. We are actively working on a comprehensive user manual that will explain all inputs and serve as a helpful guide within the community hub.

Updates and Improvements:
    • Certain buttons and text will now adjust in size based on the screen resolution, enhancing readability on handheld devices.
    • Auto-Play now blocks the "insert coin" function, preventing players from using both simultaneously. This change limits the player's ability to add coins, and it may potentially be exclusive to the Casino difficulty in the future or become an unlockable perk.

Bug Fixes:
    • Rectified an issue where the open chest dialog displayed the incorrect level of lucky charm used.
    • Addressed various spelling errors and typos throughout the game.
    • Restored the focus for game controllers on dialog cancel.

What's Next?:
    • Stay tuned for user guides covering game inputs and gameplay mechanics.
    • In-game tutorials will soon be available to assist new players.
    • Prepare yourself for the exciting Arcade Mode.
    • We're actively developing additional levels for all game modes.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We hope you enjoy the latest update!

[b]TreeNutsGames[/b]

notes.title: Quality of Life update and more content
notes.content:
[b]Hello Coiners and welcome back,[/b]

Today we have some quality of life updates, a new machine, some new levels, the ability to open your treasure chests for loot, more coins to play with, tweaks and bugfixes. 
From now on the focus will be a bit less on releasing new machines and levels so often but rather bringing the game development into it's next phase.
This will shift the focus on implementing new UI, Arcade mode, Object models and sounds.
As always feel free to visit the community hub. We appreciate your feedback, critiques and comments on the discussions page.

Enjoy!

[b]TreeNutsGames[/b]



[b]Quality Of Life updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reset options added. You can now reset all or specific parts of your save file. 
This allows you to, for example, reset you perks but not your unlocked level to play them with renewed challenge. Or reset your levels but keep you perks etc.
[*] Remember Hold Insert Coin and Auto Collect. (per session)
[*] Hide mouse pointer when using keyboard or controller (use Esc or click mouse to unlock)
[*] Run in background. The game can now run in background as suggested by Coiner ZenZen and won't pause when the game is unfocused. This is particularly nice for people running the game in a window on a second monitor while doing other tasks.
[/list]

[b]Tweaks and tunings:[/b]
[list]
[*] Classic level 16 pushers speed was tweaked. Back pushers slowed down a tiny bit and front pusher sped up a tiny bit for a more balanced game.
[*] Camera positions in a few machines.
[/list]

[b]Coins added:[/b]
[list]
[*] Some colourful coins where added. Please not that coins can also be found as loot in treasure chests.
[/list]

[b]Open/Use Specials:[/b]
[list]
[*] Silver treasure chests and Gold treasure chests can now be opened. Different types of loot can be found in the chests, like credits, collectibles and more. Please note that the content given is based on luck and can be lower the sale price of an unopened chest. Test your luck.
[/list]

[b]New machine added:[/b]
[list]
[*] A new slotted machine was added. This machine setup features a more traditional slotted coin insert where no more then one coin can be inserted in per slot. Coins will stack standing, creating a buffer for the next push.
A small warning: Coins can still get stuck if you jam too much coins in the machine at the same spot with AutoPlay or an over powered insert coin skill or both!
[/list]

[b]Levels added:[/b]
[list]
[*] Classic level 20 was added.
[*] Zen level 11 and 12 where added
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Perk Shop Buy Window size stretching out on ultra widescreens
[*] A small bug in the level buy in window where a unloadable level would give a loading error.
[*] AutoPlay coin amount increase was not respecting the player AutoPlay level max coin amount when using the keyboard numpad +key. This bug is fixed and was also noted by Coiner ZenZen in the community hub.
[*] Other minor bugfixes as well some save game changes that prepare for scaling the game and even changing the order of some levels in the future for a more linear level vs difficulty and cost progression. 
[/list]
